subject: math
cluster: Linear equations, functions, systems, and inequalities
verificationNotes: Hand-authored; numeric answers checked with sympy.
intro: A linear function $f(x)=mx+b$ has constant rate of change $m$ (the slope) and output $b$ when $x=0$ (the y-intercept). The slope between two points is $m=\dfrac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$. In context, the slope is a rate (per unit) and the intercept is a starting amount. Evaluating $f$ at a value substitutes it for $x$; solving $f(x)=k$ finds the input giving output $k$.

items.prompt: A gym charges a $20$ dollar fee plus $5$ dollars per visit. Write $C(v)$ and interpret the slope.

steps: Cost is a start plus a rate times visits: $C(v)=20+5v$.
The slope $5$ means each visit adds $5$ dollars.
The intercept $20$ is the fixed fee at $0$ visits.
